title: Workflow Invoke Result v1
description: The typed result returned by hymenium's invoke()/run() surface after a single dispatch or resume call completes or suspends. Covers the transient single-invoke result — it does not replace handoff-to-user-v1 (single checkpoint event) or workflow-outcome-v1 (terminal states), which are separate contracts.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Always '1.0' for this schema.

workflow_id.description: Unique identifier for the workflow instance, assigned as a ULID.

status.description: Terminal status of this invoke call. 'completed' means the workflow ran to a final node; 'interrupted' means execution paused at one or more interrupt points; 'failed' means an unrecoverable error occurred.

output.description: The final node output value when status is 'completed'. Null when status is 'interrupted' or 'failed'.

interrupts.description: Interrupt checkpoints raised during this invoke call. Non-empty when status is 'interrupted'; empty when status is 'completed' or 'failed'.

node_id.description: Identifier of the workflow node that raised this interrupt.

resume_value.description: The value to supply when resuming from this interrupt. Unconstrained — producers may emit any JSON value.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the interrupt, suitable for display to an operator or user.

breakout.description: When true, this interrupt signals that execution should not automatically resume — it requires an explicit operator decision before the workflow continues.

raised_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the interrupt was raised.
